card.name: Inside words starting with T or TR
card.fires_on: Partway through a word or acronym that begins with T or TR, right after the first letters, such as tr|awlers, T|rousers, TWC, TRT, NTRK. The word is split and its remaining piece comes next.

modes.label: Split ordinary words
modes.description: The middle piece of a word beginning with tr, like trawlers or trousers.
